raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Fixes #7398. `transfer_queue.backend.SimpleStorage.num_data_storage_units` defaulted to a fixed 8. Each `SimpleStorageUnit` and the `TransferQueueController` reserve 1 CPU, and `TaskRunnerV1.run` always sets `transfer_queue.enable = True`, so every default PPO run reserves 9 CPUs before the trainer starts. On a node where Ray has fewer than 9 CPUs, one unit stays `PENDING_CREATION` and `tq.init` blocks with no error.

This PR defaults the count to `null` and resolves it to `2 * trainer.nnodes` right before `tq.init`, which matches the recommendation in the config comment. An explicit value is kept as is.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+num_data_storage_units
  - #7525 proposed the same approach and was closed by its author without review. This PR picks it up on current main, with a repro in #7398.
  - Ascend/TransferQueue#165 and #166 (fail fast and bounded startup wait in TransferQueue) were closed without merge, so TransferQueue at 5fe4e49 still blocks.
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

### Test

- New `tests/trainer/test_tq_storage_units_on_cpu.py` composes `ppo_trainer` with Hydra and checks: `nnodes=1` gives 2, `nnodes=4` gives 8, an explicit `num_data_storage_units=3` stays 3. Local run: 3 passed.
- `scripts/generate_trainer_config.sh` regenerated the four `_generated_*.yaml` files and reports clean.
- Behavior before this change, from the repro in #7398 (one local Ray node, TransferQueue 5fe4e49, Ray 2.59.0): 8 CPUs with 8 units leaves one unit `PENDING_CREATION` and `tq.init` blocked for 120 s; 8 CPUs with 2 units returns with 5 CPUs left.

### API and Usage Example

No new option. Users who relied on 8 units on a 1 to 3 node run can set it explicitly:

```bash
transfer_queue.backend.SimpleStorage.num_data_storage_units=8
```

### Design & Code Changes

- `verl/trainer/config/transfer_queue/transfer_queue.yaml`: default `null`, comment states the 1 CPU per unit cost.
- `verl/trainer/main_ppo.py`: `set_default_tq_storage_units(config)` fills the count from `trainer.nnodes` when it is `null`, called before the config is printed and passed to `tq.init`. This is the only place in verl that creates TransferQueue from config; the other `tq.init()` calls attach to the existing controller.
- Regenerated `_generated_ppo_*.yaml`.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the Contribute Guide.
- [x] Ruff check and format on changed files.
- [x] Add unit test(s).

+
+import os
+
+import pytest
+from hydra import compose, initialize_config_dir
+
+from verl.trainer.main_ppo import set_default_tq_storage_units
+
+CONFIG_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "..", "verl", "trainer", "config")
+
+
+def _compose(overrides):
+    with initialize_config_dir(config_dir=os.path.abspath(CONFIG_DIR), version_base=None):
+        return compose(config_name="ppo_trainer", overrides=overrides)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("nnodes, expected", [(1, 2), (4, 8)])
+def test_storage_units_default_to_two_per_node(nnodes, expected):
+    config = _compose([f"trainer.nnodes={nnodes}"])
+
+    set_default_tq_storage_units(config)
+
+    assert config.transfer_queue.backend.SimpleStorage.num_data_storage_units == expected
+
+
+def test_explicit_storage_units_are_kept():
+    config = _compose(["trainer.nnodes=4", "transfer_queue.backend.SimpleStorage.num_data_storage_units=3"])
+
+    set_default_tq_storage_units(config)
+
+    assert config.transfer_queue.backend.SimpleStorage.num_data_storage_units == 3

-    num_data_storage_units: 8
+    # Each unit reserves 1 CPU. null means 2 x trainer.nnodes, so each node hosts two units.
+    num_data_storage_units: null
 
     # Store large field values on node-local SSD to reduce host-memory usage.
     ssd_offload:

@@ -103,6 +103,13 @@ def run_ppo(config, task_runner_class) -> None:
         ray.timeline(filename=timeline_json_file)
 
 
+def set_default_tq_storage_units(config: DictConfig) -> None:
+    """Size SimpleStorage at two units per node unless the user set a count."""
+    simple_storage = config.transfer_queue.backend.SimpleStorage
+    if simple_storage.num_data_storage_units is None:
+        simple_storage.num_data_storage_units = 2 * config.trainer.nnodes
+
+
 @ray.remote
 class TaskRunnerV1:
     """V1 TaskRunner for PPO training."""
@@ -145,6 +152,7 @@ def run(self, config: DictConfig):
         trainer_cls = get_trainer_cls(config.trainer.v1.trainer_mode)
 
         config.transfer_queue.enable = True
+        set_default_tq_storage_units(config)
         pprint(OmegaConf.to_container(config, resolve=True))
         OmegaConf.resolve(config)
         self.config = config
